purpose.domain_detail: JMA ORCA standard medical receipt (shinryo-hoshuu) software - inpatient/outpatient patient list component
purpose.summary: This program is the patient list (kanja ichiran) component of the JMA ORCA medical receipt system. It extracts and processes patient visit records, insurance information, and billing data, writing results to a temporary indexed file and an error file. It handles multiple insurance types including self-pay, workers compensation, and public assistance.

notable_features: 42 COPY statements referencing ORCA-specific copybooks (CPPTINF, CPJYURRK, CPSRYACCT, etc.)
80 CALL statements indicating heavy use of subprogram architecture
INDEXED file organization with DYNAMIC access
OCCURS tables for insurance and department data
Japanese-language comments (EUC-JP encoded, rendered as latin-1 mojibake)
No EXEC SQL or EXEC CICS - uses MCP (message control protocol) DB access layer via MCPAREA/MCPDATA copybooks
Version history spanning 2004-2008 with named developers
verdict.notes: File decoded as latin-1 but comments are actually EUC-JP encoded Japanese text, appearing as mojibake. Source is truncated at 16000 chars out of ~107KB total. The program is part of the well-known open-source JMA ORCA medical billing system for Japan, compiled with open-cobol (now GnuCOBOL). No COMP-3 usage detected despite financial calculations, consistent with GnuCOBOL/open-cobol style.
